card.name: Unit noun right before "per"
card.fires_on: The last word of a count or amount phrase when "per" is expected next, as in "words per page", "days per week" or "name per line". Fires on the unit noun, not on "per" itself.

modes.label: Time or count units
modes.description: A counted unit such as days, minutes or words that is followed by "per" and a period or container.

modes.label: Price or dose rates
modes.description: The end of a number or measure in a rate such as cost per gallon or dose per fraction.

modes.label: Plural or noun endings before per
modes.description: A word ending inside a noun that names the thing counted, before "per".
modes.example: the mean number of l<<itters>> per fertile pair

card.writes: It boosts "per", "day", "week" and "month" and suppresses "each" and its foreign equivalents, so it favors "per" over "each" for rates.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a rate phrase like "days per week" is about to continue with "per".
